'If you've played or created an aura this turn, this gets OVERPOWER.' The Runerager Swarm sentence with overpower in place of go again, and it carried both of Runerager Swarm's defects.

(1) SHAPE: it was a STATIC_TRIGGERED on ON_PLAY, so the answer was frozen when the card was played -- and being triggered it left the printed Overpower unconditional, which is the defect that matters: the attack had overpower with no aura in sight. WHILE_STATIC gated on SOURCE_IS_ATTACK is the shape loader.conditional_keywords strips for (CR 6.2.3d).

(2) The condition only asked about CREATED auras, so a PLAYED aura -- the half the sentence names first -- did not count. EVENT_THIS_TURN 'play' carries subtypes as qualifiers, so the OR says exactly what is printed.
